delete from stg.csi_customer_order_shipment;

With ship AS
(
SELECT
	trim(sh.co_num) co_num
	,sh.co_line
	,sh.site_ref
	,CONVERT(date, 
               SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(datetimeoffset, 
                                    sh.ship_date), 
                            DATENAME(TzOffset, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()))) 
       AS ship_date
	,sh.cost
	,sh.fovhd_cost
	,sh.lbr_cost
	,sh.matl_cost
	,sh.inv_num
	,sh.price
	,sh.qty_invoiced
	,sh.qty_returned
	,sh.qty_shipped
	,sh.shipment_id
	,sh.shipment_seq
	,CONVERT(date, 
               SWITCHOFFSET(CONVERT(datetimeoffset, 
                                    sh.RecordDate), 
                            DATENAME(TzOffset, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()))) 
       AS RecordDate
	,sh.DLDeleteIndicator
FROM raw.csi_co_ship_mst as sh
)
insert into stg.csi_customer_order_shipment
Select * From ship ;
